title: Award
description: Represents an award, honor, professional/academic recognition, or academic scholarship.

name.title: Award Name
name.description: The official name or title of the award.

issuer.title: Issuing Organization
issuer.description: The organization, institution, committee, and/or person that issued the award.

date.title: Award Date
date.description: The year or date on which the award was received.

dateLabel.title: Award Date Label
dateLabel.description: The display format of the year or date on which the certification was awarded.

certificate.title: Certificate
certificate.description: A URI or relative reference to the award certificate. Null indicates that no certificate is available.

acceptanceLetter.title: Acceptance Letter
acceptanceLetter.description: A URI or relative reference to the award acceptance letter. Null indicates that no acceptance letter is available.

article.title: Related Article
article.description: A URI or relative reference to an article, announcement, or publication related to the award. Null indicates that no article is available.

sourceUrl.title: Source URL
sourceUrl.description: A URI or relative reference to an article, announcement, or publication related to the award. Null indicates that no article is available.

description.title: Description
description.description: A list of statements describing the award.
